about: Logical dependencies between tenancy facts that rules.json does not encode but a coherent file must respect. Read by generator/design.py; each adjustment is logged in the design (constraint_adjustments). Data, not code: a reader's own rule set supplies its own file or none.

constraints.note: rent already paid into deposit implies the tenant has begun to pay on deposit
no deposit intended or begun, or that question open: rent cannot be stated as already deposited
a landlord who does not know of the defect cannot have learned of it orally or in writing
a landlord who learned of the defect (orally or in writing) is not unaware of it
with the increase open, an increase notice giving cost reasons cannot be stated to exist
